context: Two teens walk in the evening
purpose: Teach: 良き/無論/何しろ/冷たく/とっくに/力強い/唐突/明かり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日、文化祭、良き思い出になった。
lines.en: Today's festival — it really will be a good memory.
lines.style: Warm satisfaction. Slight pause on the dash, settling into the feeling. Bright but genuine, not performative. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 無論、また来年も頑張ろう。
lines.en: Of course. We'll do it again next year.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Matter-of-fact, like stating something obvious between friends. No flourish — just solid. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 何しろ、最後の演奏、感動した。
lines.en: Seriously, that closing performance really moved me.
lines.style: Energy forward. Genuine emotion breaking through the surface. Light emphasis on 'moved' — not hiding how much it got to her. Earnest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 担任、ちょっと冷たく見える時あるよな。
lines.en: Though, you know... our homeroom teacher does come off cold sometimes.
lines.style: Wry observation, half-joking but testing the ground. Slight drawl on 'cold.' Leaning in conspiratorially. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、とっくに引退気分だけどね。
lines.en: I'm basically already in retirement mode from club, honestly.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. A little tired underneath the lightness. Accepting rather than sad. Trails off slightly — knows Riku gets it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、力強い演奏だったよ。
lines.en: Your playing up there was really strong.
lines.style: Direct compliment, held steady. Genuine admiration without making it weird. Eye-contact level tone. Not effusive — just honest and clear.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 唐突に、舞台、暗転したのには驚いた。
lines.en: I wasn't expecting that sudden blackout on stage, though. Caught me off guard.
lines.style: Bright recall of surprise. Quick energy on the first part, then a small laugh of recognition. Animated but not overwrought. Genuine moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 帰り、街の明かりを見ながら歩こう。
lines.en: Let's walk back through the city lights, yeah?
lines.style: Soft invitation. Gentle, not pushing. Like the natural close of something good. Warmth without weight. A small opening.
